split_policy: Reynolds-number-disjoint; POD mean, basis, spectrum and normalization use train only
validation_rationale: One pre-onset dense case and one upper-Hopf case cover the expanded dynamics range.
test_rationale: Retain the three original canonical Hopf heldouts for direct before/after comparison.
rank_selection_policy: Training spectra and training-only dynamics diagnostics only; validation and heldout projection metrics are reporting-only.
global_control_policy: Frozen global-r32 comparison is reported only for legacy labels present in the frozen global asset; new labels are explicitly unavailable for that control.
